clue.text: Top conurbation accommodating a maximum number?

indicators.note: to accommodate is to take in, so the pair of words holds the a within them

parts.note: a cap is a top, as on a bottle
a conurbation is a large urban area, a city

explanation.surface: A question about which leading metropolis can house the greatest number of people.
explanation.definitionFit: Capacity is the largest amount or number that something can hold.

clue.text: Order company doctor to get worker in?

indicators.note: to get a worker in is to bring them inside, so with in this puts the worker within the doctor
in, completing to get ... in, says the worker is placed inside the doctor

parts.note: MD, Doctor of Medicine
to man a post is to work it; a man is a worker or hand

explanation.surface: A firm's medical officer is told to take on an extra employee.
explanation.definitionFit: A command is an instruction given with authority, an order in the military sense.

clue.text: Army minister's accommodation attended by soldiers

indicators.note: attended by means accompanied by, so the soldiers come alongside, after the lodging

parts.note: a pad is informal for a flat or place to live
RE, the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps

explanation.surface: An army chaplain's quarters are visited by troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Padre is the forces' name for a chaplain, a clergyman serving with troops.

clue.text: Americans African lions mauled

indicators.note: to maul is to batter and tear apart, so the letters of the two words are torn up and reordered

explanation.surface: Some American tourists are attacked by lions in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Californians are residents of California, a US state, so they are Americans.

clue.text: Island's rocky outcrop spanning one mile

indicators.note: to span is to stretch across, so the outcrop goes around one and mile

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hilltop, as on Dartmoor in England
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: An island has a rocky peak that stretches a mile across.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'Island's' is 'is', a link to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Timor is an island in the Malay Archipelago, shared by Indonesia and East Timor.

clue.text: Good paper needed to wrap one present

indicators.note: to wrap is to enclose, so good and the newspaper go around one

parts.note: FT, the Financial Times newspaper
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Decent wrapping paper is required for a present.
explanation.definitionFit: A gift is something given to someone, which is a present.

clue.text: I feel cold, not half, somehow? I'm frozen!

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters get there in some unspecified way, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: not half means only half of the word cold is kept, its front two letters

explanation.surface: Someone shivering complains of feeling the cold, then exclaims they are frozen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not half' keeps CO from COLD; the anagram signal then rearranges IFEEL plus CO.
explanation.definitionFit: An ice floe is a sheet of floating sea ice, which might say of itself that it is frozen.

clue.text: Support some noncompliant Russians

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A few Russians who refuse to comply are given backing.
explanation.definitionFit: A truss is a framework or surgical belt that braces or holds something up.

clue.text: Depict fashionable men at weddings where receptions are held

parts.note: to draw is to depict
in means fashionable
grooms are the men getting married at weddings

explanation.surface: An artist sketches bridegrooms at the venues for wedding receptions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'receptions' suggests wedding parties, but these are rooms for receiving guests at home.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawing room is a formal room in a house where visitors are received and entertained.

clue.text: Style large or small-scale reproduction

parts.note: a mode is a style or fashion
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A choice between producing something at full size or as a miniature replica.
explanation.walkthrough: 'large or small' looks like a pair of options; 'large' gives L and 'or' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A model is a miniature copy of something, such as a model railway or ship.

clue.text: A rum ace, funny clown

indicators.note: funny means odd or peculiar, so the letters are put into a strange new order

explanation.surface: A strange top performer is a comical clown.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcel Marceau was the famous French mime artist, known for his whiteface clown character Bip.

clue.text: Celebrity not entirely graceful

indicators.note: not entirely means only part of the following word is used, the run sitting inside it

explanation.surface: A famous person who is less than wholly elegant.
explanation.definitionFit: An ace is a star performer or expert in a field, someone well known for skill.

clue.text: Final messages needing money spent by Somerset city

indicators.note: by means next to, so the city sits beside the money

parts.note: a fare is money paid for a journey
Wells is a small cathedral city in Somerset, a county in south-west England

explanation.surface: Last notes left by someone who has paid to travel to a West Country city.
explanation.definitionFit: Farewells are goodbyes, the parting words said or sent on leaving.

clue.text: Modest or awfully rude, me?

indicators.note: awfully means very badly, so the letters are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether they are shy or dreadfully impolite.
explanation.definitionFit: Demure means reserved and modest in manner, the opposite of rude.

clue.text: Mum has eaten horrible animal

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother

indicators.note: horrible suggests something messed up and ugly, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mother has consumed a nasty beast.
explanation.definitionFit: The manatee is a large plant-eating sea mammal, also called a sea cow.

clue.text: Certainly at home with something to be done

parts.note: in means at home
a deed is an act, something done

explanation.surface: A firm assurance that there is a domestic task waiting.
explanation.definitionFit: Indeed is an emphatic adverb meaning truly or without doubt.

clue.text: Deceived daughter escaped

parts.note: to elude is to escape from

explanation.surface: A daughter who ran away was tricked.
explanation.definitionFit: To delude someone is to mislead them, so a deluded person has been fooled.

clue.text: Deliverer, first to call on Italian gentleman

indicators.note: first to means the opening letter of the next word is taken

parts.note: signor is the Italian title for a gentleman, like Mr

explanation.surface: A delivery person is the first to visit an Italian man.
explanation.definitionFit: A consignor is the sender who dispatches goods to someone, handing them over for carriage.

clue.text: Head cook entertaining India's leader

indicators.note: to entertain a guest is to have them in, so the cook holds the letter

parts.note: a chef is a cook

indicators.note: leader means the front letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A senior cook welcomes an Indian leader as guest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Head cook' looks like one phrase, a head chef, but 'Head' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief is a leader, the person at the top of an organisation.

clue.text: French resort invaded by English relation

indicators.note: something invaded is entered, so the English letter goes inside the resort

parts.note: Nice is a resort on the French Riviera

explanation.surface: A Riviera resort is overrun by English visitors, among them a relative.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is a family member, the daughter of a brother or sister.

clue.text: Some insolent note

indicators.note: some means a part, so the answer lies within the word that follows

explanation.surface: A rather rude letter or comment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'note' suggests a written message; here it is a note of the sol-fa scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Sol (or so) is the fifth note of the tonic sol-fa scale.

clue.text: Quiet sort of football game at first bringing resigned gesture

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
RU is rugby union, a form of football

indicators.note: at first means only the opening letter of the word is used

explanation.surface: A silent football game opens with someone giving up.
explanation.definitionFit: A shrug lifts the shoulders to show indifference or acceptance, a sign of resignation.

clue.text: One knight under emotional strain and passionate

indicators.note: in a down-style build the tense part comes after one and knight

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
N is the chess notation for knight
under emotional strain is tense; tense here stands for strained

explanation.surface: A lone knight under stress is also fervent.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'under' simply means after: TENSE follows I and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Intense means extreme in feeling, ardent and fervent.

clue.text: Rowed with a leftie — nothing to begin with

indicators.note: to begin with puts the nothing at the front, before the rest

parts.note: O looks like zero, nothing
a red is a left-winger, a socialist or communist

explanation.surface: A left-wing rower is going nowhere at first.
explanation.definitionFit: Oared means propelled with oars, so it is another way to say rowed.

clue.text: Get away from Eastern mischief-maker, retreating

indicators.note: retreating means going backwards, so these letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: an elf is a mischievous sprite

explanation.surface: Escape from a troublesome Oriental imp who is falling back.
explanation.definitionFit: To flee somewhere is to escape or run off from it.

clue.text: Communicated something confused and not up to date?

parts.note: a mess is a muddle, something confused
aged means old, not current

explanation.surface: A muddled, outdated text has been passed on.
explanation.definitionFit: To have messaged someone is to have sent them a text or note, so contacted them.
